D5/S3/Arith/MoebiusLogarithmic/CoprimeCo.name: D5.S3.Arith.MoebiusLogarithmic.sum_supported_moebius
D5/S3/Arith/MoebiusLogarithmic/CoprimeCo.signature: theorem sum_supported_moebius (q n : ℕ) : (∑ d ∈ n.divisors.filter (PrimeSupported q), ArithmeticFunction.moebius (n / d)) = if n.Coprime q then ArithmeticFunction.moebius n else 0

D5/S3/Arith/MoebiusLogarithmic/MorkenFir.name: D5.S3.Arith.MoebiusLogarithmic.MorkenFirstDivisorSum.result
D5/S3/Arith/MoebiusLogarithmic/MorkenFir.signature: theorem result (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : (∑ k ∈ (Icc 1 n).filter (fun k => k.Coprime n), moebius k) = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun d => moebius d ≠ 0), ∑ m ∈ (Icc 1 (n / d)).filter (fun m => m.Coprime d), moebius m
